name: Lumenfall
summary: Lumenfall is a free-to-play 2D side-scrolling action MMORPG set in a world of floating islands above a sea of clouds. Players start as a Wanderer and choose one of five classes (Lightblade, Starweaver, Windstrider, Moonshade and Thornwarden), each splitting into two paths, then fight in real time with combos, dodges, status effects and class ultimates. The game features party dungeons, raid bosses with shared lives, a party finder, guilds, face-to-face trading and a player market, a PvP arena, collectible souls, pets and mounts, gear forging, cloud fishing and seasonal events. It is built for landscape play on phones and tablets, with a desktop version for Windows and Mac.
